name: MTG #06 - Content QC and Approval V1.0

nodes.name: Schedule 13:00 and 01:00 JST
nodes.notes: 1h after WF05 (12:00/00:00 JST). Keep OFF until WF01-05 live tests pass. WF06 never publishes.

assignments.name: regulatory_phrases
assignments.value: P3MI|berizin|izin resmi|penempatan resmi|resmi MTGI|terdaftar resmi|agen resmi|penyalur resmi|lembaga resmi|SIP2MI|BP2MI|KP2MI

assignments.name: disclaimer
assignments.value: Informasi bersumber dari lowongan publik dan bisa berubah. Pastikan detail dan syarat resmi sebelum melamar.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: template_version, disclaimer and brand_footer MUST equal WF05 Config, otherwise every draft looks stale / lacks the disclaimer. require_ai_second_pass=false allows deterministic-only approval (test mode).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filter: { and: [ { property: 'Ingestion Source', select: { equals: 'N8N' } }, { property: 'Content Status', select: { equals: 'Draft' } } ] }, page_size: 100 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ filter: { and: [ { property: 'Ingestion Source', select: { equals: 'N8N' } }, { property: 'Content Status', select: { equals: 'Approved' } } ] }, page_size: 100 }) }}

nodes.name: Queues
nodes.notes: Input 0 = Draft, 1 = Approved (re-check for stale / ineligible jobs).

nodes.name: Flatten
nodes.notes: Rebuilds the CURRENT fact sheet + fact hash (same logic as WF05) and re-checks the job gate. Parity with WF05 is tested.

nodes.name: Fact QC
nodes.notes: Deterministic. Hash mismatch = STALE. Wrong amounts / company / position / location / job number / URL / JLPT / license / housing / experience = REJECT. AI never overrides this.

nodes.name: Parse AI
nodes.notes: AI issues count only with a verbatim quote from the stored copy. AI judges only, never rewrites.

nodes.name: QC Inputs
nodes.notes: Inputs: 0 = no AI needed, 1 = AI result.

nodes.name: Decide
nodes.notes: One decision: APPROVED / REVISION_REQUIRED / REJECTED / MANUAL_REVIEW (+ stale reset, attempts max 3, stale-loop guard). Writes only Content QC fields + Content Status.

nodes.name: Verify Write
nodes.notes: CJK corruption / silent failure check on every written property.

nodes.name: All Outcomes
nodes.notes: Inputs: 0 = no write (still valid / awaiting regen / deferred / meta), 1 = written rows.
